name: Modern Technical Fund
identity_check: Confirmed as Modern Technical Fund (MTF) at moderntechnicalfund.com, a solo-GP pre-seed and seed fund run by Amanda Robson ('Robby') that closed a $22M first fund. The lead's spelling 'Modern Technica Fund' is a variant of this name; no other firm by that name was found. Not Moderne Ventures (proptech) and not Modern Seed Industry Development Fund.

open_items: Only one round confirmed on a fetched page (Manifold Security seed). Search summaries tied MTF to Keycard's Series A and Pluto Security's seed, but the fetched Upstarts and Crypto Briefing articles do not name MTF, so neither is recorded.
Fund close date: Substack post is dated 2025-06-03 and Upstarts says a first close in January 2025; no exact final close date stated. Recorded at month precision. Lead said 2025-06-04, unconfirmed.
HQ San Francisco comes from Upstarts describing Robson as SF-based; MTF's own site states no HQ. Date for Manifold is SecurityWeek's article date.
Website portfolio page lists ~22 companies (e.g. Drata, Fossa, Keycard, RunReveal) with no round details; includes many from the GP's earlier career. No application URL or cold-inbound policy stated.
